scripts.text:
[Exorcist Master Fahae]
Greetings young warrior, I'm the Exorcist Master Fahae.
I have been tracking the elusive Bacsojin for some time.
scripts.translation:
[驱魔大师 法海]
年轻的战士，你好，我是驱魔大师 法海。
我一直在追踪行踪诡秘的巴索金。

scripts.text:
[Exorcist Master Fahae]
I feel it is time I let another warrior try to complete
my quest. I have some items to assist you in my quest.
scripts.translation:
[驱魔大师 法海]
我觉得是时候让另一位战士来完成我的任务了。
我有一些物品可以协助你完成这项任务。

scripts.text:
[Exorcist Master Fahae]
I have 2 items which might become useful to you.
scripts.translation:
[驱魔大师 法海]
我有两件物品，或许对你有用。

scripts.text:
[Exorcist Master Fahae]
How many do you require?
You may only buy 5 at one time.
Each costs 20000z.
(Type in 0 to cancel)
scripts.translation:
[驱魔大师 法海]
你需要多少？
一次最多只能购买5个。
每个售价20000z。
(输入0取消)

scripts.text:
[Exorcist Master Fahae]
Here you go, I hope you may succeed in my quest.
scripts.translation:
[驱魔大师 法海]
给你，希望你能成功完成我的任务。

scripts.text:
[Exorcist Master Fahae]
You must not be stingy, it is the path of God to be honest.
scripts.translation:
[驱魔大师 法海]
你不可以吝啬，诚实是通往神明的道路。

scripts.text:
[Exorcist Master Fahae]
The path of fully vanquishing evil is far, help me in the way of God.
scripts.translation:
[驱魔大师 法海]
彻底消灭邪恶的道路还很漫长，请助我一臂之力，走上神明的道路。

scripts.text:
[Exorcist Master Fahae]
How many do you require?
You may only buy 5 at one time.
Each costs 10000z.
(Type in 0 to cancel)
scripts.translation:
[驱魔大师 法海]
你需要多少？
一次最多只能购买5个。
每个售价10000z。
(输入0取消)

scripts.text:
[Exorcist Master Fahae]
Here you go, I hope you may succeed in my quest.
scripts.translation:
[驱魔大师 法海]
给你，希望你能成功完成我的任务。

scripts.text:
[Exorcist Master Fahae]
Money doesn't bring joy to everyone, but we need it to support the temple and myself. Please, try to kill some monsters and take their drops.
scripts.translation:
[驱魔大师 法海]
金钱并不能给每个人带来快乐，但我们需要它来维持寺庙和我的生计。请去猎杀一些魔物，收集它们的掉落物吧。
